audit_metadata.coverage: All 8 admin pages + shared components + API layer + database

system_summary.priority_recommendation: CRITICAL — Refactor monolithic pages into modular component architecture; establish centralized state management and API caching layer before scaling to 50+ admin features

major_system_issues.impact: Pages are NOT modular. All logic bundled in single file. Impossible to reuse components or share logic across pages.
major_system_issues.root_cause: No component extraction strategy; no custom hooks; inline helpers and state
major_system_issues.global_consequences: Codebase will become unmaintainable at 50+ pages. Duplicate logic across pages. Slow development velocity.

major_system_issues.impact: Each page manages its own state (search, filters, pagination, modal state). Impossible to share user preferences, auth state, or global notifications.
major_system_issues.root_cause: useState hooks scattered across pages; no Redux/Zustand/Context setup
major_system_issues.global_consequences: Code duplication in filtering/pagination logic. Inconsistent filtering behavior. No global user settings.

major_system_issues.impact: Multiple identical API requests on same page view. No React Query or SWR. Manual loading/error state handling duplicated across pages.
major_system_issues.root_cause: Direct adminService.method() calls. Manual useState for loading/error. No caching middleware.
major_system_issues.global_consequences: Network waste. Slow perceived performance. Inconsistent loading states.

major_system_issues.impact: UI components (Table, Card, Modal, Button) duplicated inline across pages. Colors/spacing inconsistencies.
major_system_issues.root_cause: Components not extracted to components/ folder. Styles inline or scattered.
major_system_issues.global_consequences: Design inconsistencies. Hard to implement global theme changes. Poor code maintenance.

major_system_issues.issue: No Lazy Loading, Code Splitting, or Progressive Enhancement
major_system_issues.impact: ReviewEditorModal has lazy loading, but other modals/sidebars do NOT. Initial bundle bloated.
major_system_issues.root_cause: Dynamic imports only partial implementation. No lazy() wrapper strategy.
major_system_issues.global_consequences: Slower page load times. Lower FCP/LCP scores for large dashboards.

major_system_issues.impact: getStatusStyle(), getStatusDot(), statusLabel() defined separately in Dashboard, Orders, Products, Coupons. Hard to maintain consistency.
major_system_issues.global_consequences: Status colors/styles diverge. Change one color requires edits in 4+ files.

major_system_issues.impact: Tables resize awkwardly on mobile. Sidebars don't adapt. Search bars overflow.
major_system_issues.root_cause: Desktop-first design. Limited test on mobile viewports.
major_system_issues.global_consequences: Poor admin experience on tablet/mobile. Support requests for mobile usage.

major_system_issues.impact: Some pages show generic errors. Others show HTTP status codes. No retry mechanism for network failures.
major_system_issues.root_cause: Manual error handling in each page. No global error boundary.
major_system_issues.global_consequences: Users unsure how to recover from failures. Poor UX on slow networks.

major_system_issues.impact: Form validation logic (email, phone, coupon code) duplicated in create/edit forms.
major_system_issues.root_cause: No shared validation library or schema (Zod, Yup).
major_system_issues.global_consequences: Inconsistent validation logic. Hard to maintain. UI validation mismatches API validation.

major_system_issues.issue: Incomplete ARIA Attributes and Keyboard Navigation
major_system_issues.impact: Modal dialogs missing aria-modal and aria-labeled. Tables not screen-reader friendly.
major_system_issues.root_cause: Limited focus on accessibility. Some components have ARIA (ReviewEditorModal), others don't.
major_system_issues.global_consequences: Non-compliant with WCAG 2.1 AA. Excludes users with disabilities.

summary: The admin dashboard suffers from severe architectural fragmentation: monolithic pages (600-1200+ LOC each), duplicate logic, no caching, and poor responsive design. This analysis identifies 10 major system issues spanning UI/UX, frontend architecture, backend alignment, and database optimization. The 4-phase roadmap prioritizes extracting components, integrating React Query, standardizing patterns, and optimizing performance. Budget 1200+ hours for complete transformation. Start with quick wins (config extraction, ReviiewEditorModal verification, DataTable component) to demonstrate patterns before scaling.
